setup.variable: One victory condition and the must-meet count.

procedure: Record each condition type, its parameter range and default.
Enable one condition and run a game past its threshold; record the victory message and score sheet.
Test must-meet counts from 0 through 7 with overlapping conditions.
Test multiple simultaneous winners and continuing after victory.

documented: Victory conditions are configurable, and more than one player can win at the same time (documented-only).

The documented command-line ranges are: planets 20-100%, tech level 8-26 with 2-6 fields, score 1000-20000, exceeds-nearest 20-300%, production capacity 10-500, capital ships 10-300, turns 30-900; must-meet 0-7; minimum years 30-500 (documented-only).
All players are notified when someone wins and may continue playing (documented-only).

unresolved: The exact condition labels and default counts are not decoded.
Whether the must-meet count of 0 disables victory is unknown.
